prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-01-08, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-01-08):
| Return 3m            | -25.4% |
| Return 1m            | -6.5% |
| Return 1w            | -3.4% |
| Range position (63d) | 0% |
| 21d realized vol     | 21% |
| Last close           | 90.53 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has endured a sharp 3-month decline (-25.4%) with recent pullbacks continuing (-6.5% over 1 month, -3.4% over 1 week), suggesting ongoing downside momentum. With a flat range-position signal over 63 days and only moderate realized volatility (21%), the downside trend appears likely to persist over the next ~20 trading days. Given the current trend and risk, a SELL stance is warranted.

DECISION: SELL
